Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/recycle_bin/form_templates/%7Bid%7D/restore")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
